verdict.rationale: A live probe returned HTTP 200 for a structured llms.txt at developers.heygen.com, and a second llms.txt at www.heygen.com covers products and the MCP connection. First-party docs state that every endpoint ships with llms.txt and typed schemas so agents like Claude and Cursor can work without glue code, and an MCP overview page is documented. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec at standard paths (all probed paths returned 404), and no independent or community corroboration of agents using these docs in practice.
